description: This source file defines the implementation of AdoNetClusteringProviderBuilder, a class responsible for configuring ADO.NET based clustering providers for Orleans silos and clients. It includes methods to set up the clustering options based on configuration sections, and uses extension methods to integrate AdoNet clustering into the Orleans hosting pipeline.

classes.name: AdoNetClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A class implementing IProviderBuilder for configuring ADO.NET clustering options for Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the AdoNet clustering options for an ISiloBuilder or IClientBuilder based on provided configuration section.
